name: 80903 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80903 (Colorado Spgs) has 252 nonprofit organizations. 115 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80903 (Colorado Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80903 (Colorado Spgs) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.0 times the typical level).
